positions.title: Lead Member of Technical Staff - Data Science
Civic Technology Fellow
positions.description:
Technical role developing software and analyzing for non-profits and governments. Projects included:

SomervillePublic Schools– Web application in python (Flask) to ensure classrooms are equitably distributed, used D3.js for visualizations and deployed to Azure

Somerville Public Schools – Cleaned data and built regression models in R to analyze the impact of summer school and after school programs on student test scores

Museum of Science – Wrote R script to parse data from DocumentDB and created PowerBI dashboard as part of team building system to capture exhibit feedback from video feed of visitors

positions.title: Planning and Commercial Finance Leader
positions.description:
Led a team of 4 people to execute all financial planning and analysis, reporting, pricing, and customer credit activities across the company, working closely with the executive team and board of directors and reporting directly to the CFO. Grew team from 1 to 4 people due to consistently increased responsibilities

Led, reviewed, and coordinated the strategic business plan of the company, including developing a multi-million dollar budget and investment plan

Managed relationships with equity/debt investors and grant providers, including developing presentations, reporting company performance, and negotiating terms for multi-million dollar capital raises

Managed a multi-million dollar portfolio of customer receivables spanning 20+ countries

Led the procurement and set up of company business intelligence systems, including vendor trials, contract negotiations, partner coordination, and data preparation and presentation

positions.title: Associate Consultant - Public Private Partnerships
positions.description:
Led the development of the financial plan, including the financial model and the plan document, for a new rail line's $900 million grant from the US Department of Transportation.

Developed and programmed a capital planning tool for the a state's department of general services that reduced the development time for their capital budget from 8 months to 2 months. During the process worked and led multiple stakeholders throughout various state departments to facilitate the creation of capital plans for more than 200 projects, including renovations and new construction of multiple schools, hospitals, and historical sites, worth over $4 billion

Developed the financial model for the California High Speed Rail’s operating plan. Utilized and presented analysis based on the model to leadership of the high speed rail project in order to determine where and when to build specific segments of the rail line

positions.title: Financial Analyst
positions.description:
Citi Transaction Services - Global Financial Planning & Analysis Group

Managed the process and worked with complex models for the Federal Reserve’s stress tests in order to determine the impact that an economic downturn would have on the business.

Developed a model to estimate the impact of foreign exchange movements on the revenues and expenses of the business every month, integrating data from Citi’s own financial systems as well as Bloomberg. The model was incorporated into the monthly forecasting process for Citi’s Institutional Clients Group, whose total revenues are greater than $30 billion annually

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Prepared and presented company overviews (in the form of PowerPoint presentations) to the firm’s President in preparation for meetings with potential clients, and the information presented was utilized to help successfully obtain new clients for the firm

Provided research support for the firm’s client engagements, intellectual capital development, and business development. The research helped to reduce the time principals spent on client engagements and led to a new engagement with a previous client

Developed a “mini-consulting” project as part of the internship, in which I assisted in the development of an innovation framework for the firm, in order to gain more consulting experience and add more value to the firm

positions.title: Development Through Trade Program Intern
positions.description:
Researched and analyzed information on African regional integration, global trade flows, financial services integration in Southern Africa, and the Low-Carbon Economy of South Africa for reports for various organizations including the World Bank, OECD, and the American Chamber of Commerce

Prepared presentations focusing on African regional integration and multi-lateral economic governance that were used by the program head in conferences around the world

company.name: South African Institute of International Affairs (SAIIA)

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Performed administrative and management duties including answering phone calls and replying to letters and emails, and
researched pressing congressional issues (used by the Congressman and other staffers to draft legislation and determine the Congressman’s votes on issues) for Congressman Solomon Ortiz
